(`r`.`recorded_at` > `cs`.`closed_at`)) group by `r`.`clinic_id`,`p`.`cash_session_id`) `pr` on(((`pr`.`clinic_id` = `s`.`clinic_id`) and (`pr`.`cash_session_id` = `s`.`id`))))

vw_collection_events.definition: select `p`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`p`.`id` AS `source_id`,'PAYMENT' AS `event_type`,`p`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,`p`.`effective_at` AS `occurred_at`,`p`.`received_by` AS `actor_id`,`p`.`method` AS `method`,`p`.`amount` AS `signed_amount`,`p`.`cash_session_id` AS `related_cash_session_id` from `payments` `p` where (`p`.`status` = 'CONFIRMED') union all select `r`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`r`.`id` AS `id`,'PAYMENT_REVERSAL' AS `PAYMENT_REVERSAL`,`p`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,`r`.`recorded_at` AS `recorded_at`,`r`.`created_by` AS `created_by`,`p`.`method` AS `method`,-(`r`.`amount`) AS `-r.amount`,`p`.`cash_session_id` AS `cash_session_id` from (`payment_reversals` `r` join `payments` `p` on(((`p`.`clinic_id` = `r`.`clinic_id`) and (`p`.`id` = `r`.`payment_id`)))) union all select `f`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`f`.`id` AS `id`,'REFUND' AS `REFUND`,`f`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,`f`.`effective_at` AS `effective_at`,`f`.`created_by` AS `created_by`,`f`.`method` AS `method`,-(`f`.`amount`) AS `-f.amount`,`f`.`cash_session_id` AS `cash_session_id` from `refunds` `f`

vw_current_communication_consents.definition: select `ranked`.`id` AS `id`,`ranked`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`ranked`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`ranked`.`prospect_contact_id` AS `prospect_contact_id`,`ranked`.`subject_key` AS `subject_key`,`ranked`.`channel` AS `channel`,`ranked`.`purpose` AS `purpose`,`ranked`.`destination_hash` AS `destination_hash`,`ranked`.`status` AS `status`,`ranked`.`recorded_at` AS `recorded_at`,`ranked`.`event_sequence` AS `event_sequence`,`ranked`.`policy_version` AS `policy_version` from (select `c`.`id` AS `id`,`c`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`c`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`c`.`prospect_contact_id` AS `prospect_contact_id`,`c`.`channel` AS `channel`,`c`.`purpose` AS `purpose`,`c`.`destination_hash` AS `destination_hash`,`c`.`destination_ciphertext` AS `destination_ciphertext`,`c`.`encryption_key_id` AS `encryption_key_id`,`c`.`status` AS `status`,`c`.`recorded_at` AS `recorded_at`,`c`.`recorded_by` AS `recorded_by`,`c`.`proof` AS `proof`,`c`.`policy_version` AS `policy_version`,`c`.`event_sequence` AS `event_sequence`,`c`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`c`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,`c`.`subject_key` AS `subject_key`,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `c`.`clinic_id`,`c`.`subject_key`,`c`.`channel`,`c`.`purpose`,`c`.`destination_hash` ORDER BY `c`.`event_sequence` desc )  AS `position_in_stream` from `communication_consents` `c`) `ranked` where (`ranked`.`position_in_stream` = 1)

vw_device_sync_health.definition: select `d`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`d`.`id` AS `device_id`,`d`.`name` AS `name`,`d`.`status` AS `status`,`d`.`last_sync_at` AS `last_sync_at`,`d`.`last_accepted_sequence` AS `last_accepted_sequence`,coalesce(`c`.`pending_count`,0) AS `received_commands_pending`,coalesce(`c`.`conflict_count`,0) AS `received_commands_in_conflict` from (`enrolled_devices` `d` left join (select `sc`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`sc`.`device_id` AS `device_id`,sum((case when ((`cr`.`status` in ('RECEIVED','WAITING_DEPENDENCY')) or (`cr`.`id` is null)) then 1 else 0 end)) AS `pending_count`,sum((case when (`cr`.`status` = 'CONFLICT_REQUIRES_REVIEW') then 1 else 0 end)) AS `conflict_count` from (`sync_commands` `sc` left join `sync_command_results` `cr` on(((`cr`.`clinic_id` = `sc`.`clinic_id`) and (`cr`.`command_id` = `sc`.`id`)))) group by `sc`.`clinic_id`,`sc`.`device_id`) `c` on(((`c`.`clinic_id` = `d`.`clinic_id`) and (`c`.`device_id` = `d`.`id`))))

vw_invoice_balances.definition: select `i`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`i`.`id` AS `invoice_id`,`i`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`i`.`number` AS `number`,`i`.`origin` AS `origin`,`i`.`issued_at` AS `issued_at`,`i`.`due_date` AS `due_date`,`i`.`total_gross` AS `total_gross`,coalesce(`p`.`received`,0) AS `payments_confirmed`,coalesce(`r`.`reversed`,0) AS `payment_reversals`,coalesce(`c`.`credited`,0) AS `credits_issued`,coalesce(`f`.`refunded`,0) AS `refunds_confirmed`,((((`i`.`total_gross` - coalesce(`c`.`credited`,0)) - coalesce(`p`.`received`,0)) + coalesce(`r`.`reversed`,0)) + coalesce(`f`.`refunded`,0)) AS `signed_balance`,greatest(0,((((`i`.`total_gross` - coalesce(`c`.`credited`,0)) - coalesce(`p`.`received`,0)) + coalesce(`r`.`reversed`,0)) + coalesce(`f`.`refunded`,0))) AS `amount_due`,greatest(0,((((-(`i`.`total_gross`) + coalesce(`c`.`credited`,0)) + coalesce(`p`.`received`,0)) - coalesce(`r`.`reversed`,0)) - coalesce(`f`.`refunded`,0))) AS `refundable_credit` from ((((`invoices` `i` left join (select `payments`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`payments`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,sum(`payments`.`amount`) AS `received` from `payments` where (`payments`.`status` = 'CONFIRMED') group by `payments`.`clinic_id`,`payments`.`invoice_id`) `p` on(((`p`.`clinic_id` = `i`.`clinic_id`) and (`p`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`)))) left join (select `p`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`p`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,sum(`r`.`amount`) AS `reversed` from (`payment_reversals` `r` join `payments` `p` on(((`p`.`clinic_id` = `r`.`clinic_id`) and (`p`.`id` = `r`.`payment_id`)))) group by `p`.`clinic_id`,`p`.`invoice_id`) `r` on(((`r`.`clinic_id` = `i`.`clinic_id`) and (`r`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`)))) left join (select `credit_notes`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`credit_notes`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,sum(`credit_notes`.`amount_gross`) AS `credited` from `credit_notes` where (`credit_notes`.`status` = 'ISSUED') group by `credit_notes`.`clinic_id`,`credit_notes`.`invoice_id`) `c` on(((`c`.`clinic_id` = `i`.`clinic_id`) and (`c`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`)))) left join (select `refunds`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`refunds`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,sum(`refunds`.`amount`) AS `refunded` from `refunds` group by `refunds`.`clinic_id`,`refunds`.`invoice_id`) `f` on(((`f`.`clinic_id` = `i`.`clinic_id`) and (`f`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`id`)))) where (`i`.`status` = 'ISSUED')

vw_patient_account_balances.definition: select `vw_invoice_balances`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`vw_invoice_balances`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,count(0) AS `invoice_count`,sum(`vw_invoice_balances`.`amount_due`) AS `amount_due`,sum(`vw_invoice_balances`.`refundable_credit`) AS `refundable_credit` from `vw_invoice_balances` group by `vw_invoice_balances`.`clinic_id`,`vw_invoice_balances`.`patient_id`

vw_revenue_events.definition: select `i`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`i`.`id` AS `source_id`,'INVOICE' AS `event_type`,`i`.`id` AS `invoice_id`,`i`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`i`.`issued_at` AS `occurred_at`,`i`.`issued_by` AS `actor_id`,`i`.`total_gross` AS `signed_amount` from `invoices` `i` where ((`i`.`status` = 'ISSUED') and (`i`.`origin` = 'NATIVE')) union all select `c`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`c`.`id` AS `id`,'CREDIT_NOTE' AS `CREDIT_NOTE`,`c`.`invoice_id` AS `invoice_id`,`i`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`c`.`issued_at` AS `issued_at`,`c`.`issued_by` AS `issued_by`,-(`c`.`amount_gross`) AS `-c.amount_gross` from (`credit_notes` `c` join `invoices` `i` on(((`i`.`clinic_id` = `c`.`clinic_id`) and (`i`.`id` = `c`.`invoice_id`)))) where ((`c`.`status` = 'ISSUED') and (`i`.`status` = 'ISSUED') and (`i`.`origin` = 'NATIVE'))

vw_stock_lot_balances.definition: select `l`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`l`.`id` AS `stock_lot_id`,`l`.`stock_position_id` AS `stock_position_id`,`l`.`item_id` AS `item_id`,`l`.`expires_on` AS `expires_on`,`l`.`status` AS `status`,coalesce(`m`.`physical`,0) AS `ledger_on_hand`,coalesce(`r`.`reserved`,0) AS `central_reserved`,coalesce(`a`.`allocated`,0) AS `offline_allocated`,((coalesce(`m`.`physical`,0) - coalesce(`r`.`reserved`,0)) - coalesce(`a`.`allocated`,0)) AS `central_available`,`l`.`on_hand` AS `cached_on_hand`,`l`.`reserved` AS `cached_reserved`,`l`.`offline_allocated` AS `cached_offline_allocated` from (((`stock_lots` `l` left join (select `stock_movements`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`stock_movements`.`lot_id` AS `lot_id`,sum(`stock_movements`.`signed_quantity`) AS `physical` from `stock_movements` group by `stock_movements`.`clinic_id`,`stock_movements`.`lot_id`) `m` on(((`m`.`clinic_id` = `l`.`clinic_id`) and (`m`.`lot_id` = `l`.`id`)))) left join (select `stock_reservations`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`stock_reservations`.`stock_lot_id` AS `stock_lot_id`,sum(((`stock_reservations`.`quantity` - `stock_reservations`.`consumed_quantity`) - `stock_reservations`.`released_quantity`)) AS `reserved` from `stock_reservations` where ((`stock_reservations`.`device_allocation_id` is null) and (`stock_reservations`.`status` = 'ACTIVE')) group by `stock_reservations`.`clinic_id`,`stock_reservations`.`stock_lot_id`) `r` on(((`r`.`clinic_id` = `l`.`clinic_id`) and (`r`.`stock_lot_id` = `l`.`id`)))) left join (select `device_stock_allocations`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`device_stock_allocations`.`stock_lot_id` AS `stock_lot_id`,sum(((`device_stock_allocations`.`allocated_quantity` - `device_stock_allocations`.`consumed_quantity`) - `device_stock_allocations`.`returned_quantity`)) AS `allocated` from `device_stock_allocations` where (`device_stock_allocations`.`status` in ('ACTIVE','CLOSING')) group by `device_stock_allocations`.`clinic_id`,`device_stock_allocations`.`stock_lot_id`) `a` on(((`a`.`clinic_id` = `l`.`clinic_id`) and (`a`.`stock_lot_id` = `l`.`id`))))

vw_stock_position_balances.definition: select `p`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`p`.`id` AS `stock_position_id`,`p`.`item_id` AS `item_id`,`p`.`location_id` AS `location_id`,coalesce(`m`.`physical`,0) AS `ledger_on_hand`,coalesce(`r`.`reserved`,0) AS `central_reserved`,coalesce(`a`.`allocated`,0) AS `offline_allocated`,((coalesce(`m`.`physical`,0) - coalesce(`r`.`reserved`,0)) - coalesce(`a`.`allocated`,0)) AS `central_available`,`p`.`on_hand` AS `cached_on_hand`,`p`.`reserved` AS `cached_reserved`,`p`.`offline_allocated` AS `cached_offline_allocated` from (((`stock_positions` `p` left join (select `stock_movements`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`stock_movements`.`position_id` AS `position_id`,sum(`stock_movements`.`signed_quantity`) AS `physical` from `stock_movements` group by `stock_movements`.`clinic_id`,`stock_movements`.`position_id`) `m` on(((`m`.`clinic_id` = `p`.`clinic_id`) and (`m`.`position_id` = `p`.`id`)))) left join (select `stock_reservations`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`stock_reservations`.`stock_position_id` AS `stock_position_id`,sum(((`stock_reservations`.`quantity` - `stock_reservations`.`consumed_quantity`) - `stock_reservations`.`released_quantity`)) AS `reserved` from `stock_reservations` where ((`stock_reservations`.`device_allocation_id` is null) and (`stock_reservations`.`status` = 'ACTIVE')) group by `stock_reservations`.`clinic_id`,`stock_reservations`.`stock_position_id`) `r` on(((`r`.`clinic_id` = `p`.`clinic_id`) and (`r`.`stock_position_id` = `p`.`id`)))) left join (select `device_stock_allocations`.`clinic_id` AS `clinic_id`,`device_stock_allocations`.`stock_position_id` AS `stock_position_id`,sum(((`device_stock_allocations`.`allocated_quantity` - `device_stock_allocations`.`consumed_quantity`) - `device_stock_allocations`.`returned_quantity`)) AS `allocated` from `device_stock_allocations` where (`device_stock_allocations`.`status` in ('ACTIVE','CLOSING')) group by `device_stock_allocations`.`clinic_id`,`device_stock_allocations`.`stock_position_id`) `a` on(((`a`.`clinic_id` = `p`.`clinic_id`) and (`a`.`stock_position_id` = `p`.`id`))))
